added_lines: . amen november novena 2026 in honour of the holy souls weekend masses in st. brendan’s october 31st & november 1st concluding with cemetery sunday november 1st 3.00pm john buckley sharing the story of the tragic death of his daughter ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ blessing of graves carrig - nov 1st after 9.30am mass clonoghill - nov 1st 3.00pm we invite everyone to attend either ceremony in conclusion with your november novena. ~~~~ mile buíochas! a thousand thanks to everyone who made our november novena in honour of the holy souls such a success. thanks to all the speakers who shared their life experiences. to the combined choirs of the brendan pastoral area who came together on different nights to share their talents. to everyone who made such a great effort in attending and spreading the word of the novena. to everyone who helped to make our novena such a success - brian, for organising readers, elaine for eucharistic ministers, mary, marie & teresa for the hospitality, a word of thanks to the young adults from the jpii in st. brendan’s to the collectors, eucharistic ministers and readers. to the parish team (fr. arnold, fr. michael, fr. tom, vonnie & joan) for their work in preparing for the novena. to sharon in the parish office who looked after the administration and social media. to all of you for your support with your attendance & your prayers. last and not least we remember our holy souls to whom the novena was dedicated. sponsored by padre pio prayer group please pray for the souls of james dooley , ballybritt, brother of the late susan whelahan, parkrise paddy walsh , chesterfield close & formerly shinrone, brother of margaret kelly & tess o’rourke, mcauley drive, birr michael hogan , sandymount/newbridge street renata (renée) strauss , bellefield, shinrone josie spain , birr community nursing unit & kinnitty birr
